source.title: Humpback whale song
source.author: NOAA Fisheries, Northeast Fisheries Science Center, Passive Acoustics Branch
source.notes: 8 kHz mono MP3 (about 40 kbps), 55 s of song: units of 0.6-4 s at 50-500 Hz, up to 31 dB over the sea's background. Each clip a phrase of one to three units, about as long as the old whale clips (4-10 s). Low fidelity, but the calls are well inside its band, and the mod plays them underwater.
